preconditions.description: The number of points on the mountain, which is at least 1 and at most 10^6.
The heights of the mountain at each point, starting from the foot and going up to the summit. Each height is between 0 and 10^12, inclusive, and they are strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers representing the heights of the mountain after the landslide has stopped.
The heights after the landslide are still strictly increasing.
